newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPC signs agreement with Dassault.
newsitem.headline: IPC signs agreement with Dassault.

text.p: Singapore-based IPC Corporation said on Friday it has agreed to distribute the products of French technology conglomerate Dassault Automatismes et Telecommunications in Asian markets.

The agreement calls for computer maker IPC to distribute Dassault's electronic payment products, equipment, and software to large and mid-sized retailers in the Asia-Pacific region, the company said in a press release.
"Electronic commerce is a revolution that is rapidly gaining momentum in the retail sector and its associated vertical markets such as banking," IPC Corporation Chairman and CEO Patrick Ngiam said.
